_comment: Pre-registered held-out test sets for the clean benchmark (script/clean_bench.py). Labels follow the clean-set rules (pyleos/tests/clean_set.json: IUPAC ionic approximation, Allen electronegativity, homonuclear bonds split equally) and were committed before any test calculation existed, so they cannot have been tuned to results. A case is scored only once its 'dir' points at the recomputed data; dir = null means the calculation has not landed. Amendments made before any test calculation was scored are listed under "amendments"; the labels of the remaining cases were not touched.

test_regression._comment: The 12 clean-set cases whose archived data had unlocalised (stray) WFs. Element references come from pyleos/tests/reference_os.json and site specs from clean_set.json; the archived data is never scored for this split. Recomputation and choice of the scored input: see protocol.
test_regression._wannier_status_comment: Outcome of the recomputation under the scored-input rule, from Wannier quality only (Omega, convergence, reproducibility across starts, stray count); recorded before any oxidation state was computed on recomputed data. unconverged = at least one spin channel had no converged start (fe3o4, tio, rb3auo, rbpb: 0 of 17 starts per channel converged within 200000 iterations; feo, mno: spin 2). Unconverged cases are scored advisory-only. Plugins get the recomputed centres and spreads and NELECT(Wannier); the EOSCAR #WF block is dropped because its per-WF occupations belong to the archived gauge (script/test_bench.py).

protocol.recomputation: Every case is re-Wannierised with gpuw90 from the overlap export (.mmn/.amn/.eig/.win) of the archived run itself, i.e. the run that produced the archived EOSCAR; no VASP run is repeated. v1 oxides: git 2f14831^. fe3o4, tio, rb3auo, rbpb, ruo2: the SAI run directories (GPU nvhpc data). wcl3, wcl4: the Chinahpc run directories with the corrected structures (CPU Intel data). Starts per spin channel: the standard start plus 16 seeded random unitary gauges; steepest descent, conv_tol 1e-10 over 3 iterations, 200000-iteration cap, stability probe.
protocol.scored_input: The scored input of a case is the recomputed Wannier set that keeps the archived problem definition (same .win: num_bands, num_wann, disentanglement windows) and has the lowest total Omega among the runs that converged and whose minimum was reached by at least two independent starts to within 1e-3 A^2. Variants that change num_wann (occupied-only) are stored as separate entries and are never the scored input. A spin channel in which no start converged is marked unconverged; the case keeps its lowest-Omega end point, is scored advisory-only and is left out of the pass/fail count. The rule uses Wannier quality only and was fixed before any oxidation state was computed on recomputed data.

v1_oxides.feo: multi-start minimum; spin 1 converged, spin 2 unconverged: advisory-only
v1_oxides.mno: multi-start minimum; spin 1 converged, spin 2 unconverged: advisory-only; occupied-only variant stored separately, not scored
v1_oxides.reo3: multi-start minimum; both spins converged (seeds 13 and 2: the minimum is a near-degenerate ladder, Omega within 2.5e-4 A^2)

test_homonuclear._comment: New non-magnetic compounds with homonuclear bonds and unambiguous IUPAC labels. Every element pair passes the clean-set convention filter (Allen |dchi| >= 0.15 and Allen/Pauling agree on the order). Site specs use the clean-set syntax; the count rule for BaS3 distinguishes the central S (2 S neighbours) from the terminal S (1). Structures: experimental, registered under structures before computing (n2h4: experimental cell and N positions, modelled H).

protocol.computation: VASP 6.4.3 + LEOS v3.1 (GPU nvhpc build) on SAI with the INCAR of the dev waves (m4_wave2) plus ISPIN = 1 and LWRITE_MMN_AMN = .TRUE.; in-situ library-mode Wannierisation. Gamma-centred k-mesh N_i = max(1, round(25 A / |a_i|)), the rule that reproduces all 38 archived wave inputs, with two exceptions fixed before computing: s8 3x3x3 (the literal 2x2x3 fails the wannier90 b-vector search) and inse 6x6x6 (the literal 3x3x3 gives a 12 A image distance on the acute rhombohedral cell, against 17-27.5 A in the waves). PBE.54 POTCARs as in the waves; without wave precedent: Li, In_d, Si, Ba_sv, Hg.
protocol.scored_input: The EOSCAR and Wannier centres of the in-situ run are the scored input when that run has no stray WF (pyleos criterion: spread > 3.0 A^2 or centre farther than 1.6 A from every atom). A case with stray WFs is re-Wannierised with gpuw90 from its own overlap export under the test_regression rule and that set is scored instead, the in-situ result being reported alongside. The choice uses Wannier quality only, never oxidation states.
protocol.geometry_decisions: Deposited coordinates are kept wherever a file exists: li2o2 keeps the Foppl z(O) = 0.651 (O-O 1.515 A; Chan 2011 gives 1.564 A); hg2cl2 keeps the neutron-powder coordinates (Hg-Hg 2.595 A; Dorm 1971 gives 2.526 A). cac2: C z reset from the deposited 0.38 (C-C 1.53 A) to 0.4065 (Atoji 1961 neutron, C-C 1.191 A) and duplicate sites merged. na2s2, li2o2, gas: 0.3333/0.6667 restored to exact 1/3 and 2/3. n2h4: cell and N positions of Collin & Lipscomb 1951; the 8 H are modelled (rigid gauche molecule, N-H 1.02 A, N-N-H 110.0, H-N-H 106.5 deg, rotation about N-N at the minimum of a point-charge Ewald energy) and are not relaxed. The labels do not depend on any of these choices.
